meta_data.base_class: Initiate a transaction... using <a specific type of bank card>. This is a tool where the payment method is hardcoded to a specific card network or type (e.g., Visa, Mastercard), removing the `payment_method` parameter.

tool_template.name: Payment_1_Make<class>Payment
tool_template.description: Initiate a transaction to send a specified amount of money to a friend or contact using the <class> payment method.

amount.description: The monetary value to send, using <class> payment platform.

receiver.description: The identifier of the contact or account to receive the payment. This could be a username, phone number, or email address.

private_visibility.description: A flag indicating whether the transaction should be hidden from public transaction feeds.

currency.description: The currency in which the transaction is to be conducted using the <class>. This specifies the currency code like USD, EUR, etc.

note.description: An note or message that be attached to the transaction using the <class> payment method for the receiver's reference.

notify_receiver.description: A flag indicating whether the receiver should be notified of the transaction of <class> payment via email or SMS.

transaction_category.description: A category for the transaction of <class> payment (e.g., 'Food', 'Rent', 'Travel') for the sender's own tracking or budgeting purposes.
